name: @knowget/learning-intelligence
description: Learning Intelligence & Educational Insights Platform (P2-D11) — the capstone academic domain that synthesizes the descriptive indicators of the learner and academic domains (student lifecycle, wellbeing, attendance/presence, teaching-learning, assessment) into a unified per-learner intelligence profile and explainable educational insights: evidence-bearing learning signals, rule-based early warnings, findings, human-in-the-loop recommendations, growth plans and cohort insights. Descriptive and explainable only — ML prediction/forecasting is deferred to the intelligence core (P2-D28).
